refsection.title: Description
refsection.para:
The `SilikoFunctionCallerInstall` installs a single function into a `SilikoFunctionCaller` object.
* `Caller` is the `SilikoFunctionCaller` object to install the function into. * `FunctionName` is a string that will be used as the identifier for the installed function. * `Function` is a pointer to a C function implementing the Siliko function being installed.

refsection.title: Return Values
refsection.para: Returns true if the installation succeeded, false otherwise.
